instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Develop a system that combines the functionalities of a shift register and a comparator. The comparator should have two inputs, each of which is a 4-bit binary number. The output of the comparator should be high if the two numbers are equal, and low if they are not. The shift register should have 8 D flip-flops with active high synchronous reset, triggered by the negative edge of the clock. The reset signal should reset all the flip-flops to 0. The functional module should take the output of the comparator and use it to control the shift register. If the output of the comparator is high, the shift register should shift the input data to the left by one bit position and insert a 0 in the least significant bit position. If the output of the comparator is low, the input data should be stored in the shift register without shifting. The final output should be the contents of the shift register.
